s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Battery Negative Terminal
Remove Rear Tire
Remove Front Floor Brace Center

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and the front floor brace center.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Exhaust Tail Pipe Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and 2 compression springs.
Disconnect the 2 exhaust pipe supports and remove the exhaust tail pipe assembly.
Remove the gasket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Exhaust Pipe Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and 2 compression springs.
Remove the 4 exhaust pipe supports and remove the center exhaust pipe assembly NO.2.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Skid Control Sensor Wire

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector from the skid control sensor.

atten3.ptxt: Do not twist the skid control sensor wire.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Parking Brake Lever Protector

s2.ptxt: Remove the parking brake lever protector from the parking brake cable assembly No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.3

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the cable end from the operating lever of the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.
Using an offset wrench (14mm), disconnect parking brake cable assembly No.3 from the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.

atten4.ptxt: Insert the offset wrench all the way into the clip as shown in the illustration, flex the clip, and pull parking brake cable assembly No.3 out of the guide of the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.2

atten4.ptxt: For parking brake cable assembly NO.2, use the same procedure as for parking brake cable assembly NO.3.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Suspend the caliper with wire or equivalent.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: For the rear disc brake caliper assembly RH, use the same procedure as for the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Disc LH

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and remove the disc.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Disc RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and remove the rear axle hub & bearing assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Height Control Sensor Sub-assembly Rear

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector and disengage the clamp.
Remove the 2 bolts and remove the height control sensor assembly (rear).

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Suspension Member Brace LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 bolts and remove the rear suspension member brace LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Suspension Member Brace RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Stabilizer Link Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the nut and remove the rear stabilizer cushion.
Remove the nut and remove the rear stabilizer link assembly LH.

atten4.ptxt: Using socket hexagon wrench 6, hold the stud bolt so that it does not spin.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Stabilizer Link Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Stabilizer Bar Rear

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and the 2 rear stabilizer bar brackets No.1.
Remove the rear stabilizer bar.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the nut of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH (rear axle carrier LH side).
Install SST to the stud bolt of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1LH.

atten3.ptxt: Install SST so that it is aligned with the top end of the stud bolt of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, separate the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH from the rear axle carrier LH.

item.ptxt: To prevent SST from falling, be sure to tie it to the rear axle carrier LH with a string so that the string does not slacken.
Install the SST so that A and B of the SST are parallel.
Be sure to apply the wrench at the position shown in the illustration.
Do not damage the ball joint boot of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and nut, and remove the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH from the rear suspension member.

atten3.ptxt: Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.1 RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Trailing Arm Assembly Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Loosen the 2 bolts of the trailing arm assembly rear.

atten3.ptxt: Only loosen the bolts; do not remove them.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Trailing Arm Assembly Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.2 LH

s2.ptxt: Loosen the 2 bolts of the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH.

item.ptxt: Only loosen the bolts and nuts; do not remove them.
Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.2 RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Carrier LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and nut, and disconnect the upper control arm assembly rear LH from the rear axle carrier.

item.ptxt: Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.
Suspend the rear drive shaft assembly LH with wire or equivalent.
Do not damage the drive shaft outboard joint boot.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolts and nuts, and remove the rear axle carrier from the trailing arm assembly rear and rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Carrier RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Shock Absorber Assembly Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Support the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH with a jack, with a block of wood in between.
Remove the bolt and nut, and disconnect the rear shock absorber assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Shock Absorber Assembly Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Coil Spring Rear LH

s2.ptxt: With the rear shock absorber disconnected, gradually lower the jack and remove the rear coil spring insulator upper LH and rear coil spring LH together.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Coil Spring Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Coil Spring Insulator Upper LH
Remove Rear Coil Spring Insulator Upper RH
Remove Rear Coil Spring Insulator Lower LH
Remove Rear Coil Spring Insulator Lower RH
Remove Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.2 LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and nut, and remove the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH.

atten3.ptxt: Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.2 RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Upper Control Arm Assembly Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and nut, and remove the upper control arm assembly rear LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Upper Control Arm Assembly Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Suspension Member Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and 4 nuts, and remove the rear suspension member.
